parameters.name: GrantType
parameters.description:
The VBRs that need to acquire permissions on the VPC. Valid values:

*   **All**: Permissions on the VPC are granted to all VBRs that belong to the specified region and Alibaba Cloud account. In this case, you can leave **VbrInstanceIds** empty.
*   **Specify**: Permissions on the VPC are granted to the specified VBRs. **VbrInstanceIds** must be assigned a value.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the VPC is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: VbrOwnerUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the VBR belongs.

parameters.name: VbrRegionNo
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the VBR is deployed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc grant-instance-to-vbr --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-owner-uid 1210123456123456 --vbr-instance-ids vbr-m5ex0xf63xk8s5bob0000,vbr-bp1h6efd7a5g66xxd0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1lqhq93q8evjpky0000 --grant-type All --vbr-region-no cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
